lookback.description: Default window for sync, digest and ask (e.g. 3d, 12h). Capped by lookbackMax.

retention.description: prune drops posts older than this.

selectors.description: Which posts to keep (bay/selector.py). The default `{id: home}` has no fields: it keeps everything each bound source's default stream returns (X: the home timeline), exactly as v0.2. Add e.g. {id: staking, in: list:123} or {id: vitalik, from: vitalik}; X handles from, in (home, list:<id>) and since natively, text locally (billed before it filters).

costPerPostUsd.description: Price per post a source reads (timeline + deletion checks), used for the spendUsd cap. Unset: bay/config.py COST_PER_POST_USD ($0.005); a connector may declare its own (fake: 0).
